SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 te Oxhaku, prane zones se Xhamllikut.
Apartamenti ndodhet në një zone te qete dhe mjaft te kerkuar te qytetit.
▪ Tipologji: 1 dhome gjumi, ambient ndenjeje sebashku me kuzhinën, 1 tualet dhe nje koridor i bollshem.
▪ Pozicionohet ne katin e 4-të banim, apartamenti ka ndriçim natyral gjatë gjithë ditës.
▪ Shitet i mobiluar, si ne foto.
▪ Apartamenti eshte rinovuar totalisht, sistem kapote, elektrike, hidraulike, tualeti etj.
▪Zona ofron facilitete te shumta si, spitali, shkolla, kopshte, markete etj.
▪ Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Për më shumë informacion ose për ta vizituar, na kontaktoni!
description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE in Oxhaku, near the area of ​​Xhamllik. The apartment is located in a quiet and highly sought-after area of ​​the city. ▪ Typology: 1 bedroom, living room together with the kitchen, 1 bathroom and a spacious corridor. ▪ Positioned on the 4th residential floor, the apartment has natural lighting throughout the day. ▪ Sold furnished, as in the photo. ▪ The apartment has been completely renovated, hood system, electrical, hydraulic, toilet, etc. ▪ The area offers many facilities such as hospital, school, kindergartens, markets, etc. ▪ Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or to visit, contact us!
